purpose: Independent alternative mechanism and degree-only diagnostics if predeclared development signal passes; not extra LFR seeds nor new algorithm tuning

alternative.extra_membership_assignment: uniform other community for a graph-seeded random subset of round(n*overlap_fraction) nodes
alternative.probabilities: S shared unordered pair count; Q=n*(n-1)/2; target E=10*n; p_shared=(1-mu)*E/S; p_unshared=mu*E/(Q-S); independent Bernoulli for each pair; invalid probabilities fail without retry
alternative.distinction: global expected external fraction is not LFR per-node native mu; balanced planted cores unlike LFR power-law community sizes; degree stochastic not hard-capped

degree_only.rank_weights: w_i=clip(c/i,1,50); deterministic bisection chooses c with mean(w)=20; graph-seeded random permutation
degree_only.edge_probability: min(w_u*w_v/sum(w),1), each unordered pair independent; no self-loops
degree_only.truth: no planted communities, no complete recovery labels and no strict macro/micro F1
degree_only.NOCD_model_order: fixed n/50 capacity chosen before null generation; separate fixed_K_null_diagnostic panel, never called oracle K
degree_only.reported_diagnostics: completion/cost/RSS, cover count/sizes/coverage/membership/overlap rate and reconstruction behavior; no fitted clusters labeled true or false via invented ground truth

randomness: Seeded NumPy PCG64 per case, source/version pinned; related parameter grid not IID datasets
controls: freeze chosen one global primitive with elementwise and BMM/CSR direct controls plus strongest related existing methods before any confirmation results. No case/n/truth-dependent backend policy.
execution_condition: Only after complete73/74/75 gate signal and final algorithm/confirm protocol freeze; candidate sources remain unchanged after confirmation feedback
round_deadline: original work/state.json unchanged; no second-round allocation
